title: Holcombe Rucker Park National Commemorative Site Act
official_summary:
Holcombe Rucker Park National Commemorative Site Act

This act designates Holcombe Rucker Park, in Harlem, New York, as the Holcombe Rucker Park National Commemorative Site. The act also allows the Department of the Interior to enter into cooperative agreements with appropriate entities (e.g., New York City) for interpretive and educational purposes related to the site.

summary.headline: A new law names Holcombe Rucker Park in Harlem, New York, a national commemorative site and lets the Interior Department work with partners on educational programs there.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially designates Holcombe Rucker Park in Harlem as the Holcombe Rucker Park National Commemorative Site. It allows the Department of the Interior to enter into cooperative agreements with groups such as New York City for interpretive and educational purposes related to the site. The summary does not describe new funding, fees, or rules for visitors.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 4, 2025; the official summary does not list a separate effective date.
